pride_data.title: Complexome profiling of human mitochondrial proteins
pride_data.projectDescription: Protein complexes from isolated and crosslinked human mitochondria were separated using BN-PAGE. The gel lanes were then divided into 20 slices each, with each slice subsequently digested. The resulting peptides were analyzed, and the data from DIA runs were utilized for complexome profiling of mitochondrial complexes, including AIFM1, AK2, other proteins, and OXPHOS complexes.
pride_data.sampleProcessingProtocol: Human mitochondria were isolated and treated with the crosslinker DSSO. Both the treated sample and an untreated control were then subjected to BN-PAGE to separate the protein complexes. Each gel lane was divided into 20 slices, and the proteins in each slice were digested. The resulting peptide fractions were analyzed using LC-MS, and DIA runs were performed to identify and quantify the peptides and proteins in each fraction.
pride_data.dataProcessingProtocol: The data obtained from the DIA runs were processed using DIA-NN software. The resulting `report.pg_matrix.tsv` file was utilized to normalize the selected proteins across the two different conditions (DSSO-treated and control).
